title: SF1429 (2023-2024 Regular): Criminal background checks requirement for firearms transfers

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-02-07; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/1429/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text. The 624.7134 transfer rules cover pistols and assault weapons only, unlike the 2019 bill. Struck text left out of quotes. Version read: introduced text (as filed). No passage vote is recorded for this bill.

operative_text:
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.7134, subd. 2): A person who is not a firearms dealer is prohibited from transferring possession or ownership of a pistol or semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to any other person who is not a firearms dealer, unless the transferee presents a valid transferee permit issued under section 624.7131 and a current state or federally issued identification.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7131, subd. 4): A chief of police or sheriff shall refuse to grant a permit to a person who is a danger to self or others.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.7131, subd. 4): The decision of the chief of police or sheriff must be based on documented past contact with law enforcement.
